name: Slayer Tower Basement
accessNote: Task-only basement. Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task and Raulyn stops off-task attacks; the Gargoyles task page lists 12 spawns and safespot support. Safespotting requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock for Abyssal demons. Bloodveld access is task-only, can be reached from the tower with a Slayer ring route, and may be less busy.

travel.note: Fairy ring CKS by the Slayer Tower, then descend to the basement (needs a Dramen or Lunar staff).
